import networkx as nx
import random

def find_graph():
    for trial in range(1000):  # try 1000 random graphs
        # Generate random graph with degrees between 3 and 6
        deg_seq = [random.randint(3,6) for _ in range(15)]
        if sum(deg_seq) % 2 != 0:
            continue  # must be even
        try:
            G = nx.configuration_model(deg_seq)
            G = nx.Graph(G)  # remove multiedges
            G.remove_edges_from(nx.selfloop_edges(G))  # remove loops
            if len(G.edges()) < 20: continue  # rough
            # check degrees
            degrees = list(dict(G.degree()).values())
            if min(degrees) < 3 or max(degrees) > 6:
                continue
            # check girth
            if nx.girth(G) >= 6:
                return G
        except:
            continue
    return None
